module.Title: Define a Player Class
module.Teaching: A class is a blueprint for objects. It groups related data and behavior under one type.
module.PredictionExplanation: The class describes what future Player objects can contain and do.
module.DebugPrompt: C# class declarations begin with the class keyword followed by the type name.
module.RecallPrompt: Define an empty Player class from memory.
module.PreviewMessage: The player now has an object-oriented blueprint.
